item.title: Viral NATO video falsely framed as ‘war propaganda’ against Russia
item.description: A viral NATO video is being falsely framed online as “war propaganda”, with users accusing the Alliance of sharing a “promotional video” designed to prepare the public for imminent war with Russia.
